$comment: Place at .claude/settings.json in the repo root and COMMIT it — cloud sessions in the Claude app start from a fresh clone and only see committed config. Rules evaluate deny > ask > allow; first match wins. In cloud sessions the VM is itself the sandbox and git push is proxy-restricted to the current working branch, so 'git push' is allowed here. defaultMode 'acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits. These rules reduce approval prompts; the disposable VM provides the real safety boundary (no --dangerously-skip-permissions needed in the app).
